DOC-LEAVE.name: Leave policy
DOC-LEAVE.text:
Full-time staff get 20 days of paid vacation a year.

Give at least 14 days' notice for vacation of more than two days, and 2 days' notice for shorter vacation.

Sick leave is reported to your manager before your shift starts.

DOC-LEAVE-2024.name: Leave policy (2024)
DOC-LEAVE-2024.text: Give at least 7 days' notice for any vacation.

DOC-EXPENSES.name: Expenses policy
DOC-EXPENSES.text:
Claim expenses within 30 days with an itemized receipt.

Mileage is paid at the rate in the finance handbook.
